title: Initialized pool values
statement: For every natural number $N$, every machine memory $m$ with $W$-bit values, and every natural number $n\le N$, after the straight-line initialization of the constant registers and pool, the value at pool address $c_{\mathrm{Pool}}(n)=-(25+4n)$ is the $W$-bit representation of $n$.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ is a memory assigning a $W$-bit value to each integer address
